# Course build: Year <N> <subject>

Working record for one build. Keep it at
`.superpowers/course-builds/year<N>-<subject>.md` (gitignored) so resumed
sessions need not rediscover the build. When the build finishes, move what lasts
into the repo (see the end) and discard this file.

- Request and deliverable: <new course, rollout, or revision>
- Branch: <build branch>
- Statutory source: <verbatim programme file and topic mapping>
- Registry/entry points: <current combination or explicit additions>
- Permanent IDs: <chosen before shipping; existing IDs preserved>
- Year-award participation: <preserve existing membership; staged additions explicitly false>
- Existing recipe: <subject game/bank, lessons, tests>
- Visual baseline: <built subject/year; illustrated notes/worked examples, question diagrams/manipulatives>
- Pilot topic: <representative interaction and evidence before scaling>
- File ownership: <which agent owns which files>

| Topic ID | Four slots / lessons implemented | Technical evidence | Content/device review remaining |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

Validation: <focused checks and scope; adapter limitations; full lint/tests/build once before merge/release, or explicitly pending>

Next action: <one line>

## When finished, move into the repo

- The statutory mapping table → the subject's file in `docs/curriculum/`.
- Topic/challenge counts → `docs/CURRICULUM_INVENTORY.md`.
- Content, device and owner review still needed → "Outstanding review" in
  `docs/OPERATIONS.md`.
- Reusable workflow lessons → `docs/AUTHORING.md` or the templates.
